transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 6 Airport — Railway Station runs from about 6:00 to 23:00: on weekdays 78 trips in each direction, at weekends 61. Suburban trains from Aeroport platform run via Volgograd-1 to Shpalopropitka, ticket 52.20 ₽, children under 7 free; 4 trains a day from the airport, the first at 14:36.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge of domestic terminal С2 on Level 2, airside after security, open round the clock. Admits business class passengers, premium bank customers and members of loyalty programmes; any passenger can pay for a single visit with the lounge agent. Stay up to 2 hours.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage on Level 1 of the domestic terminal, for domestic and international passengers, open round the clock. First calendar day 500 ₽ per item, each following day 100 ₽. An identity document is required; item size no more than 75 × 60 × 65 cm, storage up to 90 days.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child rooms are in the domestic (С2) and international (C) terminals, free and open round the clock, for up to 24 hours. For children under 7 and women in the second half of pregnancy with a departure ticket, an identity document and a certificate from the health post.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Wi‑Fi in the terminal complex: network Airport in the public halls, AirportZPK in the premium comfort lounges. Login via a free call, Gosuslugi or a code from SMS/Push.
